card.name: Mardani Jhumar
card.tagline: The martial men's variant of the Jhumair harvest dance
card.profile: Mardani Jhumar (also Mardana Jhumair) is the vigorous, martial men's variant of the Jhumar/Jhumair folk dance of the Sadan (Nagpuri-speaking, Indo-Aryan) and Adivasi communities of the Chotanagpur region, performed in Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Odisha (Wikipedia, Jhumair; Folk dances of Jharkhand). Danced by men after the harvest at fairs, performers wear ghungroo and dance in a circle holding each other's hands, with movements reflecting masculine and martial energy (the Veera/valorous mood); some sources class it, like the Paika, as a semi-martial form (EZCC). Musical accompaniment includes the mandar, nagara, dhak and shehnai/bansi (EZCC; Wikipedia).
card.insight: Mardani Jhumar is the male counterpart to Janani Jhumar (the women's variant); together they form part of the Nagpuri dance-song repertoire, distinguishing it from the parent Jhumair tradition while remaining closely related to it (Wikipedia, Jhumair).
